newsitem.title: USA: Harvey to develop animated children's show.
newsitem.headline: Harvey to develop animated children's show.

text.p: Harvey Entertainment Co on Thursday said it hired a writer to develop an animated children's series for television based on the cartoon character Wendy the Witch.

The writer, Sherri Stoner, worked on the development of the "Casper" animated series, currently airing on the Fox Kids network. She also worked on the development of the "Tiny Toons" and "Animaniacs" programs for Amblin/Warner Bros.
Stoner's feature film writing credits include the upcoming Walt Disney Co film "My Favorite Martian," Harvey said.
